name: Backstory
mission: Rebuilds the decisions behind code from its git history.
flowAlt: Data flow: read the history, where git log gives every commit with per-file line counts, comments in the current code that give a reason are traced to their commit with git blame, and both become signals such as dependency changes, reverts, refactors, config changes and rationale words. Find decisions, where linked signals are grouped into candidates, ranked by score, and PR and issue text is attached from GitHub within a request budget. Write the record, where a model writes one ADR per candidate (or an evidence-only record without a model), the result is saved as numbered markdown files, index.json and a timeline viewer, and the why command and MCP tool look records up without a model call.

nodes: lines at HEAD that give a reason
traced to a commit by blame
revert with the commit it undoes
one PR, a dependency rolled back
